mapper.select: SELECT ra.id AS areaId, ra.area_code AS areaCode, ra.area_name AS areaName, ra.status AS areaStatus, COUNT(dc.id) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occ.desk_chair_id IS NULL AND dc.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS availableCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occ.desk_chair_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS occupiedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occ.desk_chair_id IS NULL AND dc.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabledCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occ.desk_chair_id IS NULL AND dc.status = 1 THEN dc.capacity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalCapacity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN occ.desk_chair_id IS NOT NULL THEN dc.capacity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS occupiedCapacity, COALESCE(MAX(lost.pendingLostCount), 0) AS pendingLostCount FROM reading_area ra LEFT JOIN desk_chair dc ON ra.id = dc.area_id AND dc.status >= 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT i.desk_chair_id FROM seat_hold_item i INNER JOIN seat_hold_batch b ON i.batch_id = b.id WHERE b.status = 'OPEN' AND i.item_status IN ('HOLDING', 'TIMEOUT') ) occ ON occ.desk_chair_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT area_id, COUNT(*) AS pendingLostCount FROM lost_item WHERE status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY area_id ) lost ON lost.area_id = ra.id GROUP BY ra.id, ra.area_code, ra.area_name, ra.status ORDER BY ra.area_code

SELECT dc.area_id AS areaId, t.id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.tag_color AS tagColor, COUNT(dc.id) AS deskChairCount FROM desk_chair_tag dct INNER JOIN desk_chair dc ON dct.desk_chair_id = dc.id AND dc.status >= 0 INNER JOIN tag t ON dct.tag_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 WHERE dc.area_id = #{areaId} GROUP BY dc.area_id, t.id, t.tag_name, t.tag_color ORDER BY deskChairCount DESC, t.tag_code

SELECT dc.area_id AS areaId, t.id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.tag_color AS tagColor, COUNT(dc.id) AS deskChairCount FROM desk_chair_tag dct INNER JOIN desk_chair dc ON dct.desk_chair_id = dc.id AND dc.status >= 0 INNER JOIN tag t ON dct.tag_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 GROUP BY dc.area_id, t.id, t.tag_name, t.tag_color ORDER BY dc.area_id, deskChairCount DESC, t.tag_code

SELECT log.created_at AS createdAt FROM area_change_log_00 log INNER JOIN desk_chair dc ON log.desk_chair_id = dc.id AND dc.status >= 0 WHERE log.created_at >= #{start} AND log.created_at < #{end}
AND (log.old_area_id = #{areaId} OR log.new_area_id = #{areaId})
